Announced by Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin, the ferries are expected to be operational by 2030. This initiative will strengthen maritime transport and diminish reliance on overland pathways through Lithuania amid ongoing tensions. Given Kaliningrad's strategic location, these ferries are crucial for enhancing Russia's military logistics in the region.
